market.question: Iran closes its airspace by May 24?

en.title: Iran Airspace Closure Odds Plummet
en.summary: The probability of Iran closing its airspace by May 24th has sharply declined to 15% as the deadline approaches without direct action. This movement was primarily driven by recent reports of a "largely negotiated" Iran deal.
drivers: Trump's "largely negotiated" Iran deal statement
Approaching May 24 deadline without closure
UAE's "Gulf is open" statement
en.why_matters: Airspace closure would severely disrupt global aviation, impact trade routes, and signal a significant escalation of regional tensions, affecting international stability.
en.bull_case: A breakdown in negotiations or new regional provocations could prompt Iran to close its airspace as a retaliatory measure.
en.bear_case: Ongoing negotiations and a lack of immediate threats suggest Iran will avoid airspace closure by the deadline.

zh.bull_case: 谈判破裂或新的地区挑衅可能促使伊朗关闭空域作为报复性措施。
zh.bear_case: 持续的谈判和缺乏直接威胁表明伊朗将在截止日期前避免关闭空域。

en.title: Trump Nears Hormuz Deal
en.summary: The probability surged to 60% after Donald Trump announced on May 24, 2026, that a peace deal with Iran was "largely reached" and included opening the Strait of Hormuz. This direct statement from the former President significantly boosted market confidence in an imminent agreement.
drivers: Trump's public statements on Iran deal progress
Multiple news outlets confirming Trump's announcement
Report of US-Iran ceasefire extension talks

en.title: US-Iran Peace Deal Hopes Surge
en.summary: The probability of a US-Iran permanent peace deal by May 2026 surged 23% to 38% following multiple reports of significant progress in negotiations. Headlines from Chicago Tribune, Forbes, and Bloomberg indicated both nations are "close to" or "near" a comprehensive agreement.
drivers: Reports of US-Iran nearing a comprehensive peace deal.
Donald Trump stating deal is "largely negotiated."
Signals of progress in ongoing peace talks.
en.why_matters: A permanent peace deal between the US and Iran would fundamentally reshape Middle East geopolitics, potentially stabilizing the region and impacting global energy markets.
en.bull_case: Widespread reports of both nations being "close to" a comprehensive deal, including Trump's confirmation of advanced negotiations, strongly indicate a breakthrough is imminent.
en.bear_case: Despite progress, Bloomberg notes "Issues Unresolved," and deep-seated historical distrust and domestic political opposition could still derail any final agreement.

zh.title: 美伊和平协议希望大增
zh.summary: 随着多方报道称美伊和平谈判取得重大进展，到2026年5月31日达成永久和平协议的可能性飙升23%至38%。《芝加哥论坛报》、《福布斯》和彭博社的头条新闻均指出两国“接近”达成全面协议。

持续和平谈判中出现进展信号。

zh.bull_case: 广泛报道称两国“接近”达成全面协议，包括特朗普证实谈判进展，强烈预示突破在即。
zh.bear_case: 尽管有进展，彭博社指出“问题仍未解决”，根深蒂固的历史不信任和国内政治反对仍可能阻碍最终协议。
